# Edge Cases — Test Reference
# These test boundary conditions and security scenarios.

# EC-7: Empty text
(empty string)
→ Expected: 1 atomic requirement (preserved as-is, no error)

# EC-7: Whitespace-only
"   "
→ Expected: 1 atomic requirement (preserved as-is, no error)

# EC-8: PolicyDocument with zero requirements
→ Expected: document returned unchanged

# EC-9: Exceeds max split count (>50 splits)
must X and must Y and must Z ... (51+ conjunction-verb pairs)
→ Expected: 1 atomic requirement (preserved as-is, warning logged)

# EC-10: Mixed case normative verbs
Systems Must enforce MFA and Must require passwords
→ Expected: 1 atomic requirement (unchanged — case-sensitive matching)

# ReDoS resistance (SC-007, SEC-4)
10KB+ repetitive string: "Systems must X " repeated 1000 times
→ Expected: completes in <1 second (regex crate linear-time guarantee)

# Unicode edge cases (SEC-4)
Zero-width space between conjunction and verb
→ Expected: no panic, handled gracefully

# Bidirectional override characters
→ Expected: no panic or corruption

# Multi-byte UTF-8 characters in requirement text
→ Expected: preserved correctly
